name: KeyInputCondition
description: Key-input gate on the player action vtable +0x120. Up to 3 checks (button, type, arg) through the input object vtable +0xB0, with fallback KeyInputFallback for button 1. Live 11-19: this returns 0 on the long martial-art holds (held frames under-count) and 1 on the normal ones.

name: MoveSpeedTick
description: Per-slot move tick: speed = base x mult stored at ctrl+0xDC4, step at ctrl+0x40 = speed x frame scale ctrl+0xDC0, written at MoveSpeedTick_StoreStep.

name: MoveSpeedTick_StoreStep
description: Store of the per-slot step inside MoveSpeedTick.

name: MoveKeyScan
description: Move branch-key scan (this, moveRes, time t, slot). Fires keys in [t, t+step). Half-step split when Is30Fps (0x20e8f8) is true. Callers AnimKeyScanTick, 0x236224c, 0x9e4eac.

name: MoveKeyRangeCheck
description: Range-key helper used by MoveKeyScan on the same [t, t+step) window.

name: MoveKeyTime
description: Returns one key's time from the move resource. MoveKeyScan compares it to the current anim time.

name: KeyCondSlotC0
description: Player action vtable +0xC0. The 11-19 note cites 0x2e9934, which is 8 bytes inside this 20-byte entry.

name: SetMoveBody
description: Set-move body. SetMoveWrapper returns into the top of this function.

name: AnimKeyScanTick
description: Calls MoveKeyScan at AnimKeyScanTick_Call with the current anim time.

name: AnimKeyScanTick_Call
description: Call site of MoveKeyScan inside AnimKeyScanTick.

name: SetMoveWrapper
description: Generic set-move wrapper (vtable data ref 0x4e57448). The branch decision is upstream in MoveKeyScan.

name: SetMoveWrapper_Return
description: Return from SetMoveWrapper into SetMoveBody.

name: MoveSpeedKeyTime
description: Time of one speed key in the move resource, read by MoveSpeedMultWriter.

name: KeyFlagSlotE8
description: Player action vtable +0xE8. Live 11-19: returns 1 in long holds and 2 in normal holds (flag bit 15 of ctrl+0xA8).

name: HeldFramesAtSetting
description: Input vtable +0x140. Returns frames held times 60 divided by the fps setting at settings+0x614. Live 11-19: at a 120 setting and ~90 real fps this under-counts by 1-3, so a held>=12 key misses.

name: KeyFlagSlotF0
description: Player action vtable +0xF0. The 11-19 note cites 0xa02308, which is inside this entry.

name: MoveSpeedMultWriter
description: Writes the move speed multiplier from up to 5 speed keys. A key inside [t, t+delta) sets mult = percent/100 and the remaining duration.

name: MoveSpeedKeyPercent
description: Percent value of speed key i in the move resource.

name: MoveSpeedBase
description: Product of 19 speed modifiers, world scale, and partner sync. Returns 0 while ctrl+0x488 or ctrl+0x48C is > 0 (freeze).

name: InputVtB0_Site
description: Site the 11-19 hold note calls input vtable +0xB0. functions.tsv places it inside MoveSpeedBase, then HeldInputDispatch.

name: HeldInputDispatch
description: Next function after the input vtable +0xB0 site. HeldFramesAtSetting is the getter it reaches.

name: MoveSpeedWorldScale
description: World scale multiplied into MoveSpeedBase.

name: HeldFramesSettingUser
description: One of the callers of the same 60/fps-setting conversion as HeldFramesAtSetting.

name: MoveKeyScanCaller9E4EAC
description: Caller of MoveKeyScan.

name: KeyInputFallback
description: Fallback input check used by KeyInputCondition for button 1, type <= 1 or 0xD.

name: MoveKeyScanCaller236224C
description: Caller of MoveKeyScan.

name: PlayerActionVtable
description: Player action vtable. Slots used by the hold scan: +0xC0 KeyCondSlotC0, +0xE8 KeyFlagSlotE8, +0xF0 KeyFlagSlotF0, +0x120 KeyInputCondition, +0x128 ConditionListEvaluate5, +0x138 ConditionCheckSlotParamThunk.

name: InputObjectVtable
description: Input-object vtable. Slot +0x140 is HeldFramesAtSetting.

name: SpeedModifierVtable
description: One of the 19 move-speed modifier vtables read by MoveSpeedBase.

name: SpeedModifierVtable2
description: One of the 19 move-speed modifier vtables read by MoveSpeedBase.

name: SpeedModifierGateVtable
description: Move-speed modifier vtable that gates on the byte at obj+0x10.

name: SpeedModifierVtable3
description: One of the 19 move-speed modifier vtables read by MoveSpeedBase.
